notes: The profile explicitly disables NASM/Yasm SIMD because no pinned assembler exists in the current catalog. Complete original SIMD sources remain available; no SIMD performance qualification is claimed.
Shared and static libraries, TurboJPEG, CLI tools, arithmetic coding, bundled PNG/zlib and the complete upstream CTest matrix are built. Java/JNA and fuzz targets are not enabled.
JPEG is lossy. Installed probes use explicit color tolerance; lossless transforms are checked separately. These checks are not an official compiler Benchmark score.
The original raw-material profile remains in material-profile.json. Its full original source archive and metadata.catalog are unchanged.
pkg-config prefixes use ${pcfiledir}/../..; binary relocation is qualified only by the recorded independent prefixes and same target runtime ABI.

Upstream forces absolute ELF RUNPATHs. The recipe uses CMake file(RPATH_CHANGE) after installation to replace that exact field with $ORIGIN/../lib for tools and $ORIGIN for libraries, records readelf before/after, and checks independent binary prefixes. Original upstream source and codec instructions are unchanged.
